## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

Describe checks and relevant device testing. For local processing changes,
include behavior in airplane mode after setup and model versions used.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I included only synthetic data and no credentials or private records.
- [ ] Medical facts retain source evidence and uncertainty where applicable.
- [ ] I described any dependency, license, model, or network behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran relevant checks, or explained why a check could not run.
